objective: End-to-end living-world overhaul, retaining the original content, uncensored dialogue, Classic graphics, saves, and isolated branch

stages.name: Cast, visitors and all event visuals
Detailed item art, physical interactions and per-item state
Persistent autonomous lives, memories, relationships and meaningful player agency
Connected weather, ecology, habitat, economy, skills, exploration, crafting and projects
Integrated interface, save migration, regression and long-run simulation tests
Signed build, save backup, desktop installation and verification

constraints: No changes to real saves during tests
No final handoff until installed and tested
